## NHSBSA templates

| Template | Use it for | Where it is described |
|---|---|---|
| Analytical project record | Recording scope, data, method, assumptions, uncertainty, decisions and sign-off | [Section 6](../06-doing-the-work/index.qmd) |
| Quality assurance checklist | The checks required at your assurance level | [Section 6](../06-doing-the-work/index.qmd) |
| Quality assurance log | Recording checks as you do them, with what you found | [Section 6](../06-doing-the-work/index.qmd) |
| Quality assurance statement | Telling readers what was done and what the limits are | [Section 9](../09-communicating-analysis/index.qmd) |
| Assurance level decision sheet | Scoring impact and likelihood to reach your assurance level, and the Business Critical test | [Section 5](../05-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd) |

The templates and the decision sheet are held on the NHSBSA SharePoint, alongside the rest of the
analytical documentation. **Opening them needs NHSBSA network access.** If you cannot reach them,
ask the Data Science, Advanced Analytics and Statistics team.

What matters is that a template is **created in place** rather than downloaded: created in place it
is versioned and can be linked from the output, while one downloaded, filled in and saved somewhere
is a template nobody can find afterwards. The field lists are the part this playbook owns, so take
them wherever your team works.

## NHSBSA internal documents

Some of the sources named at the foot of these pages are NHSBSA's own documents rather than
published standards. They are held on the NHSBSA SharePoint and **need NHSBSA network access**.

| Document | What the playbook uses it for |
|---|---|
| Criteria for determining the level of analytical risk v3, 10 September 2026 | The assurance level decision sheet: the impact and likelihood scales, the matrix, and the worked examples. [Section 5](../05-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd) |
| NHSBSA Business Critical Analysis: Navigating the Assurance Journey, 17 September 2026 | The Business Critical definition, the six criteria, and the documentation stack. [Section 8](../08-business-critical/index.qmd) |
| NHSBSA Analytical operating model and implementation plan, Summer 2026 | What NHSBSA counts as an analytical output, and the range it covers. [Section 0](../00-how-to-use/index.qmd) |
| NHSBSA Revisions and Corrections Policy | What counts as a revision and what counts as a correction, and who decides. [Section 9](../09-communicating-analysis/index.qmd) |
| NHSBSA Statistical Disclosure Control protocol | Thresholds and methods for protecting small counts. [Section 9](../09-communicating-analysis/index.qmd) |

If you cannot reach one of these, ask the Data Science, Advanced Analytics and Statistics team.

## NHSBSA guidance

| Resource | For |
|---|---|
| [NHSBSA Analytical Code Assurance Playbook](https://nhsbsa-data-analytics.github.io/nhsbsa-analytical-code-assurance-playbook) | Version control, testing, peer review, documentation and open sourcing of analytical code |
| [NHSBSA Data Science Playbook](https://nhsbsa-data-analytics.github.io/nhsbsa-data-science-playbook) | The workflow for a Data Science initiative, from problem definition to wrap up |
| [NHSBSA Data Visualisation Standards](https://nhsbsa.github.io/nhsbsa-digital-playbook/data/data-visualisation/) | Charts, tables and dashboards, and how to label them so they can be read |
| [NHSBSA Open Data Standards](https://github.com/nhsbsa-data-analytics/open-data-standards) | How NHSBSA publishes open data |
| [Coffee and Coding](https://github.com/nhsbsa-data-analytics/coffee-and-coding) | Monthly hands-on sessions. Materials from every session since 2021 |

## NHSBSA statistics policies

These bind official and national statistics. The behaviour they describe is worth following for any
published output. [Section 9](../09-communicating-analysis/index.qmd) says where each one bites.

| Policy | For |
|---|---|
| NHSBSA Revisions and Corrections Policy | What counts as a revision and what counts as a correction, how errors are graded by consequence, and who decides |
| NHSBSA Statistical Disclosure Control protocol | Thresholds and methods for protecting small counts in a published output |

## Standards

| Standard | Applies to |
|---|---|
| [GovS 010: Analysis](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-analysis-functional-standard--2/government-functional-standard-govs-010-analysis) | All government analysis |
| [The AQuA Book](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-aqua-book) | All government analysis, as practical guidance |
| [Code of Practice for Statistics](https://osr.statisticsauthority.gov.uk/the-code-of-practice-for-statistics/) | Official statistics |
| [The Green Book](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/the-green-book-appraisal-and-evaluation-in-central-government) | Appraisal |
| [The Magenta Book](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/the-magenta-book) | Evaluation |
| [The Orange Book](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/orange-book) | Risk management |
| [Quality Assurance of Code for Analysis and Research](https://best-practice-and-impact.github.io/qa-of-code-guidance/intro.html) | Analytical code |
| [Reproducible Analytical Pipelines, NHS England](https://nhsdigital.github.io/rap-community-of-practice/introduction_to_RAP/what_is_RAP/) | Automating an analysis that is already reproducible |

### The Magenta Book supplementary guides

Where your work is an evaluation rather than an analysis, the Magenta Book has a set of
supplementary guides. Three are worth naming because they are about quality and competence rather
than about method:

| Guide | For |
|---|---|
| [Quality in qualitative evaluation](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/the-magenta-book) | A framework for appraising the quality of qualitative evaluation evidence |
| [Quality in policy impact evaluation](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/the-magenta-book) | Choosing between impact evaluation designs, and what each one can and cannot attribute |
| [Government Analytical Evaluation Capabilities Framework](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/the-magenta-book) | The competences an evaluation team needs, and how to judge whether it has them |

The rest cover realist evaluation, handling complexity, regulatory post-implementation reviews,
transparency and test and learn.

## AI and algorithmic tools

Applies where your analysis builds on, uses or evaluates an AI system. See the boundary in
[section 2](../02-standards-landscape/index.qmd).

| Resource | What it is for |
|---|---|
| [The Data and AI Ethics Framework](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/data-ethics-framework/data-and-ai-ethics-framework) | Seven principles, with recommended actions and a self-assessment tool |
| [AI Playbook for the UK Government](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/ai-playbook-for-the-uk-government/artificial-intelligence-playbook-for-the-uk-government-html) | Ten principles for building, buying and using AI |
| [Introduction to AI assurance](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/introduction-to-ai-assurance) | Assurance mechanisms, and how to measure, evaluate and communicate |
| [AI Standards Hub](https://aistandardshub.org/ai-standards-search/) | Searchable AI standards, and a training platform with e-learning on AI assurance |
| [Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard](https://www.gov.uk/government/collections/algorithmic-transparency-recording-standard-hub) | The record expected where an algorithmic tool informs a decision affecting the public |
